data.name: Bartek
data.gender_notes: Bartek is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Slavic word ‘barit’, meaning ‘bear’. Bartek is a name of strength and courage, often given to boys in Slavic cultures. The name Bartek carries the meaning “Bold, brave or strong bear” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Bartek usually hope their child will grow to embody bold, brave or strong bear and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes bravery and strength in the face of adversity
data.etymology: Bartek belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bold, brave or strong bear.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bartek total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: ברטק
in_hebrew.meaning: בן של אלוהים, משמעו בן האל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם ברטק הוא שילוב של שתי מילים עבריות, בן ובא מן השורש ברק, שמשמעותו בזק, האל, וק, שמשמעותו בן, לכן משמעות השם ברטק היא בן האל, או בן של אלוהים. השם נמצא בשימוש בקרב הנוצרים ככינוי ليسوع המשיח, ומשמש גם כשם פרטי לנוצרים.

in_greek.name: Βαρτέκ
in_greek.meaning: Υιός του Θεού, εκ του Θεού
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Βαρτέκ προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές λέξεις υιός και Θεός, που σημαίνει υιός του Θεού. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, ο Ιησούς Χριστός αναφέρεται συχνά ως ο Υιός του Θεού. Το όνομα Βαρτέκ έχει χρησιμοποιηθεί στην Εκκλησία από τους πρώτους χρόνους και αποτελεί σύμβολο της χριστιανικής πίστης.

in_latin.name: Bartek
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Bartek derivatur ex hebraicis vocibus, filius et Deus, quod significat filium Dei. In Ecclesia primitiva, Iesus Christus saepe appellatur Filius Dei. Nomen Bartek in usu est apud Christianos et significat origine divina et filiationem Dei.

in_english.name: Bartek
in_english.long_meaning: The name Bartek originates from Hebrew roots, combining 'ben' meaning son and 'El' or 'Theos' meaning God. Thus, Bartek signifies 'son of God' or 'divine origin'. In Christian tradition, Jesus Christ is often referred to as the Son of God. The name Bartek has been adopted in various Christian cultures, symbolizing spiritual sonship and divine heritage. It reflects a deep connection to biblical teachings and Christian faith.

data.cultural_impact: The name Bartek holds cultural significance as it is a variation of the Slavic name 'Bartosz' and is commonly found in Central and Eastern Europe, particularly in Poland and the Czech Republic. In these regions, bear is considered a powerful and revered figure, representing strength and fearlessness. The name Bartek symbolizes these qualities and embodies a sense of resilience and determination.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Christian context, Bartek's spiritual significance can be traced back to the biblical figure of Bartholomew, one of the Twelve Apostles of Jesus. Bartholomew's name has similar roots, with the Greek word 'Bartholomew' meaning 'son of Tholomaus' or 'son of PTOLEMY'. The name can thus be connected to the spiritual richness of the Apostolic tradition. As a Christian name, Bartek is a reminder of the steadfast commitment and faith of Bartholomew in spreading the teachings of Jesus. It represents the unwavering spiritual strength that one can draw from their faith, following the example of Bartholomew and other saints.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Bartek is a Slavic name derived from the Old Slavic word "Bart" meaning bright, illustrious, and tawny. In the Christian context, the name could symbolize a beacon of light and hope in the darkness, representing the inner strength and resilience of the individual named Bartek. It may also evoke the image of a tawny-haired saint, embodying the radiance and grace of God.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Bartek is mentioned in the 13th-century manuscript 'Codex Suprasliensis' The name Bartek carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name Bartek is associated with the medieval Kingdom of Poland

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Bartek remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: David Bartek, a minister in Dublin, Ireland, shares that their name Bartek meaning "Bold, brave or strong bear" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.
